prompt.reglas:
Flux Kontext edits the input photo from one instruction. Say what changes and, explicitly, what stays the same.
Use precise verbs: change, replace, add, remove. Avoid "transform", which changes the whole identity.
Name the subject directly ("the woman with short black hair"), never "her" or "it".
To keep a person, add "while maintaining the same facial features, hairstyle and expression". To keep the framing, add "keep the same pose, camera angle and composition".
To edit written text, quote it: Replace "joy" with "BFL".
There is no negative prompt and no weights.
